resources.string: APK backup and restore with honest privilege tiers.
Archives are .kilnbackup.zip with metadata.json. Optional AES-GCM password encryption is available. Private /data/data needs Root (Magisk opt-in or Shizuku-root).
No Shizuku: APK-only archives. Restore installs every APK in the archive (base + splits) via PackageInstaller (system confirm) or silent install when Shizuku is ready.
Shizuku is ready: backups can include Android/data and OBB for the selected package when those folders exist. Enable Magisk root opt-in in Privilege setup for /data/data (user_de deferred).

Root is available: backups can include /data/data for the selected package (CE only; /data/user_de deferred). Android/data + OBB still apply when that capability is available. Restore: install → force-stop → extract → restorecon.
HTTPS only. Password is stored encrypted on device and never exported in Kiln-Config.

Restore queued — confirm the system install dialog if shown; shared / app data restores when capabilities allow

Kiln extracts every APK in the archive (base + splits) and queues a multi-session install. When the archive includes Android/data, OBB, or /data/data and the matching privilege is available, Kiln restores those after the package is present (force-stop + restorecon for app data). A system confirm may appear. This overwrites existing app data.
Archive claims splits but only one APK was found — restore aborted so a broken install is not queued.
This device has more than one Android user. Pick which user the silent restore install should target (best-effort). Android/data and OBB still use current-user paths.
This device has more than one Android user. Tag which user this backup is intended for (best-effort). APK bytes are package-wide; Android/data and OBB still use current-user paths.
